Hydr0neFN/hinet-dual-path-probe.description: Does a static IP actually lower your game ping? A concurrent A/B of two ISP account types on one line, measured on the UDP path a Source 2 game really uses. Live data, updated hourly from the probe.
Hydr0neFN/hinet-dual-path-probe.body:
# Chunghwa Telecom CS2 Ping Spike Test: Dynamic vs. Static Plan

**Traditional Chinese** · [English](https://github.com/Hydr0neFN/hinet-dual-path-probe/blob/HEAD/README.en.md)

## TL;DR The following is written by Claude, one sentence: Apply for a static plan, the difference is huge. (varies by person)

On the same physical line, using a single Raspberry Pi to conduct a **synchronous A/B test** between two types of ISP connection modes (and measuring the **actual UDP path that Source 2 games (CS2) really use**, not just pinging some random nearby DNS server).

The median game ping won't get lower—both account types have completely identical medians on the path the game actually uses. But stability varies greatly: the dynamic plan has 1 spike exceeding 60 ms in every 6 high-frequency measurements, while the static plan has only 1 in 868 measurements. The situation behind Cloudflare is vastly different: median 3 ms vs 24 ms, and during peak times the dynamic plan spikes past 200 ms accompanied by packet loss.

The data below is automatically updated hourly by a probe running on the Pi.

# Almondyoung Server Commerce and logistics integrated operations system --- ## This Project's Vision If one own shopping mall is sufficient, it's better to use a well-built SaaS shopping mall service like Cafe24 or Imweb. This project aims to be an easy-to-extend kit with control and flexibility beyond what platforms allow, for businesses centered on commerce. To achieve this goal, it adopts a structure where you directly own the authentication model and the cost of adding new apps is low. --- ## Order Flow Example ```mermaid flowchart TB CH["Channel
Medusa · Naver · Coupang"] CA["channel-adapter"] CORE["core
sales-order · inventory"] WH["warehouse-app
Picking · Inspection · Shipping Label"] CH -->|"① Order Collection"| CA CA -->|"② orders.events.v1"| CORE WH -->|"④ HTTP"| CORE CORE -->|"⑤ fulfillment · shipment · product · inventory"| CA CA -->|"⑥ Shipment · Inventory · Product Sync"| CH ``` **① Channel → `channel-adapter`** — Collects orders from Naver · Coupang · own shopping mall (Medusa). **② `channel-adapter` → `core`** — Translated orders are passed via `orders.events.v1`. ## iOS App Maintenance

Free Apple ID signing typically expires after 7 days. When the app won't open after expiration, reconnect the iPhone and press `Cmd + R` in Xcode to reinstall and renew the signing for 7 more days:

```bash
cd /Users/max/Desktop/github/interview
source ~/.nvm/nvm.sh && nvm use 22
npx cap open ios
```

If you're only renewing the signing without changing content, you don't need to rebuild the web artifacts.

If you've modified the blog content, you need to rebuild and sync first:

```bash
cd /Users/max/Desktop/github/interview

source ~/.nvm/nvm.sh && nvm use 16.19.1
MOBILE=1 npm run docs:build

source ~/.nvm/nvm.sh && nvm use 22.22.2
npx cap sync ios
npx cap open ios
```

Then select iPhone in Xcode and press `Cmd + R` to install.

Note that you need to modify the save path and filename of the generated files. You can add different upstream ad filter lists as needed (any filter list compatible with Adblock Plus syntax is acceptable) for customization.
## Warning: This filter subscription may potentially break the functionality of certain websites and may also block certain adult and gambling websites. Please consider carefully before use. The full version may have many false positives; it is recommended to use the Lite version (containing only official AdGuard lists). Zheyi-D/quota-monitor.body:
# 🪪 Hong Kong Immigration Department Appointment Quota Monitoring

Real-time tracking of Hong Kong Immigration Department **ID Card Replacement** appointment quotas with automatic notifications via **Feishu groups + Feishu private messages** when new quotas are released.

---

## 📱 Method 1: Join the Feishu Group (Recommended)

The robot automatically pushes quota updates, **instant message delivery**, join and use immediately, no configuration required.

> 📖 **[Group Information & How to Join](https://scn7uo58gnuo.feishu.cn/wiki/QSFlwcMBmil7sGkZRBTcAWqwnCf)** (Multiple group options with automatic distribution when full)

### 💬 Method 2: Subscribe via Feishu Private Chat

If you don't want to join a group, you can **filter by date** and only receive notifications for dates you're interested in:

1. [Private chat with bot 'HKID Quota Auto-Detection'](https://applink.feishu.cn/T98uc8RbxI8c) (Send any message to trigger)
2. The bot will reply with an interactive card supporting:
   - 📅 **Subscribe to Specific Dates** — Only follow the date you booked
   - 🔔 **Subscribe to All Dates** — Get notified for all quota releases
   - 📊 **View / Modify / Cancel Subscriptions**
3. You can also reply with dates to subscribe with one click, for example `08/15, 08/20-08/25`

Supports three filtering modes:
- 📅 **By Date** — View specific dates only, all service centers
- 🏢 **By Service Center** — View specific service center only, all dates
- 🎯 **By Date + Service Center** — Exact match

> 💡 The bot private chat has a 1-2 second delay. For urgent updates, joining the group is recommended.

---

## 🖥 Dashboard

> 🖥 **[quota-monitor Dashboard](https://Zheyi-D.github.io/quota-monitor)**

- 📊 Real-time view of appointment quota status for all service centers across Hong Kong
- 📈 Quota release pattern heatmap visualizing release frequency by time period
- 📖 Includes telephone appointment booking tutorial
- 🔧 Built-in admin panel supporting subscriber management, statistics overview, and dual-channel broadcasting

---

## 📨 Notification Flow

When new quotas are detected, notifications are sent in the following order:

> **Group Broadcast** (multiple groups in parallel) → **Private Message DM** (in parallel, only sent to subscribers matching the date)

Feishu group and private message notifications arrive almost simultaneously.

---

## 🔒 Privacy and Security

- Feishu user data encrypted with **AES-256-GCM**, unreadable in repository
- Only reads quota data **publicly released** by the Immigration Department
- ⚠️ Disclaimer: This system is a third-party open-source tool, not an official Hong Kong Immigration Department service. Please refer to the official website for accurate information.

# (This repository is lightweight: suitable for GitHub Actions) Periodically scrapes multicast sources and hotel sources

## ⚠️ Note
**Adding new channels or adding local channels or other**  
1. For multicast sources, ensure rtp/province_operator.txt has the required channels, add new ones if they don't exist.
2. Add the new channel name in the channel classification CHANNEL_CATEGORIES in the script, and if needed, make mapping changes in the channel name mapping CHANNEL_MAPPING.
3. WeChat Official Account: Kakashi's TV Room

---

## Multicast Docker Version (Solves Stream Interruption)
1. Pull the image `docker pull kakaxi088/zubo` defaults to pulling the latest version

2. Start the container `docker run -d --name zubo -p 5020:5020 kakaxi088/zubo:latest` If port 5020 is occupied, you can set another port (port)

3. The container takes about 5 minutes to fetch on first startup, enter `docker logs -f zubo` to check the fetch status

4. Add or remove channels through the visual panel `http://device_ip:port`, add mappings

5. After the fetch is complete, subscribe to `http://device_ip:port/zubo.txt`.

---

## Hotel Sources Docker Version
1. Pull the image `docker pull kakaxi088/kakaxi` defaults to pulling the latest version

2. Start the container `docker run -d --name kakaxi -p 5000:5000 kakaxi088/kakaxi:latest` If port 5000 is occupied, you can set another port (port)

3. The container takes 30-60 minutes to fetch on first startup, enter `docker logs -f kakaxi` to check the fetch status

4. Add or remove channels through the visual panel `http://device_ip:port`, add mappings

5. After the fetch is complete, subscribe to `http://device_ip:port/list.txt`.

---

linking12/raft-exchange.description: Crypto Exchange, Spot, Perps, Delivery, Margin, UTA
linking12/raft-exchange.body:
# Raft-Exchange

---

This project is a high-performance matching and risk control core oriented towards spot and contract trading. Based on the classic **exchange-core** architecture, it systematizes reforms around consistency, scalability, and risk control determinism.

## Project Overview

The system adopts Raft consensus + single-write multi-stage execution model. Through user-sharded RiskEngine and trading-pair-partitioned MatchingEngine, it achieves high throughput, low latency, and clear responsibility boundaries while ensuring strong consistency.

### Overall Architecture Overview

The system is divided into the following two layers:

### 1. Raft Consensus Layer

- Implemented based on JRaft (with Aeron Cluster as an alternative implementation)
- All write requests enter the Raft Log through the Leader
- Logs are executed only after reaching consensus among the majority of nodes
- Supports snapshots and log replay for fast recovery

### 2. Exchange-Core Execution Layer

- Event-driven execution pipeline based on Disruptor
- Risk control (R1), matching (ME), and post-processing (R2) are completed in the same execution pipeline
- Supports spot and contract trading scenarios
- Built-in liquidation and risk release processes

## Supported Core Features

Based on the core capabilities of exchange-core, this project systematically extends the trading model and risk control system, mainly including:

---

### Trading and Matching Capabilities

- **Price Scaling**  
  Uniformly uses integer prices and quantities, supports trading pair configurations with different precisions, and avoids floating-point errors.

- **Unified Spot and Contract Matching Model**  
  Supports spot, spot lending, and margin contract trading under the same matching framework, sharing the same set of matching, risk control, and capital event flows.

---

### Spot Lending

- **Isolated / Cross Margin Lending**  
  Isolated lending maintains independent accounting and collateral per position; cross lending aggregates collateral and liabilities at the account level, sharing risk exposure.

- **Collateral and LTV Risk Control**  
  Uses LTV (Loan-to-Value) to measure lending risk, supports supplementing/releasing collateral, and performs risk assessment according to tiered thresholds for warnings and liquidations.

- **Lazy Interest Accrual and Interest Rate Curves**  
  Accrues interest lazily on a per-millisecond basis to avoid full traversal; interest rates are priced by kinked curves based on capital utilization. Isolated lending supports both locked interest rates (locked at opening time based on current curve value plus spread) and floating rates, while cross lending only supports floating rates.

- **Lending Liquidation and Final State Conservation**  
  Independent liquidation scanner triggers liquidation based on real-time LTV including accrued interest, completes repayment by force-selling collateral assets at bankruptcy price, and ensures capital conservation across three final states: normal repayment, liquidation, and insolvency.

- **Lending Pool and Insurance Fund (LIF)**  
  Lending funds are operated in pool form, supporting capital injection and withdrawal; interest income is collected separately and withdrawn uniformly by the operator. Insolvency losses are covered by the Lending Insurance Fund (LIF), and liquidation fees are also included in LIF as a reserve.

---

yaoshining/github-insights.body:
# GitHub Insights 📊

> Daily tracking of GitHub popular projects, AI open-source dynamics, and technology trends

## Directory Structure

```
github-insights/
├── README.md                      # Project homepage
├── index.html                     # Latest report entry point
├── reports/
│   └── 2026/
│       └── 03/
│           ├── index.html         # Monthly report index
│           └── 2026-03-25.html    # Daily report
└── posts/                        # In-depth articles/series topics
    └── template.html             # Article template
```

## Series Description

- **Daily Reports (reports/)**: Daily GitHub Trending popular projects selection
- **Articles (posts/)**: In-depth technical analysis, project reviews, trend interpretation

## Publishing

Website entry: [GitHub Insights](https://yaoshining.github.io/github-insights/).

New daily reports use `reports/YYYY/MM/DD.html`, following complete Chinese HTML and responsive dark card layout. Dates are calculated in Beijing time, noting data collection time, source, and ranking criteria; total stars and daily additions are recorded separately. Data snapshots can be saved in `DD.json` in the same directory.

After completing the daily report, rebuild and check the entry point in the repository root directory:

```bash
python3 scripts/update_indexes.py
python3 scripts/validate_site.py YYYY-MM-DD
```

The index script automatically updates the homepage's latest report, recent daily reports, yearly and monthly archives, is compatible with old filenames, preserves historical URLs, and other versions of the same day are listed in the monthly index. Only indexes existing daily reports. After validation, check the homepage and daily report's desktop and mobile displays, commit the daily report along with the index, and confirm the corresponding GitHub Pages deployment is successful.

```bash
# Local preview
open index.html

# Automatically deploys to GitHub Pages after pushing to GitHub
```

## Daily Report Sharing Long Image

Clicking "Generate Sharing Long Image" on the day's report allows previewing and saving as PNG; browsers that support file sharing will display "Share Image". Mobile users can also long-press to preview and save the image, then share to social media. The image retains the complete daily report, including the GitHub Insights website title and a QR code pointing to the current day's report. Images are generated locally in the browser and not uploaded to the server.
